quickAnswerTitle: Kansas School Calendars Are Set by District
quickAnswer: Kansas does not publish one statewide K–12 attendance calendar. State law establishes the minimum school term and allows a local board to adopt a days-based or hours-based calendar, but each district publishes the dates families follow. The four reviewed 2026–27 districts begin student attendance on August 12 or 13 and finish their main K–11 schedules on May 25 or 26. Opening days, grade scope, conferences, early dismissals, professional days, and year-end schedules still differ by district.
about:
Kansas public school calendars are local schedules operating within a statewide school-term framework. K.S.A. 72-3115 sets a days-based minimum of 186 school days for kindergarten through grade 11 and 181 days for grade 12. A district board may instead adopt an hours-based policy: at least 465 hours for kindergarten, 1,116 hours for grades 1–11, and 1,086 hours for grade 12. Those requirements do not create one Kansas first day, Spring Break, or last day.

The current Kansas collection includes reviewed 2026–27 and 2027–28 calendars for Blue Valley Schools, Olathe Public Schools, Shawnee Mission School District, and Wichita Public Schools. For 2026–27, Blue Valley and Shawnee Mission begin selected grades August 12. Olathe begins selected grades with a half day August 13, while Wichita lists August 13 as its first day after an August 12 orientation for students in grades 6–12 who are new to their building.

The four calendars also show why grade and program scope matter. Blue Valley separates grades 6 and 9 Transition Day, EC–8 conference closures, K–5 collaboration days, and high-school finals. Olathe uses a three-step opening for selected K–12 grades, all K–12 students, and Early Childhood. Shawnee Mission staggers three opening dates and separates Pre-K from the K–11 ending. Wichita distinguishes student recess from administrative-office closure dates and publishes districtwide conference, nonteaching, and conference-release days.
calendarRulesDescription: Kansas sets the minimum school term and closure framework, while local boards and districts publish the dates, grade scope, and operating details families use.

calendarRules.label: No statewide student calendar
calendarRules.description: Kansas school districts publish their own first days, breaks, conference schedules, professional days, early dismissals, and last days.

calendarRules.label: Districts may use days or hours
calendarRules.description: State law provides a days-based school term, but a local board may adopt an hours-based policy and notify the Kansas State Board of Education for that school year.

calendarRules.label: Grades 1–11 require 1,116 hours under the hourly option
calendarRules.description: The statutory hourly alternative lists at least 1,116 hours for grades 1–11 and 1,086 hours for grade 12. Kindergarten has a separate 465-hour statutory minimum.

calendarRules.label: Weather decisions are local
calendarRules.description: A district board or its designee may close schools for hazardous driving conditions and may schedule additional days or hours to compensate for closures.

calendarRules.label: Conference and staff time can affect the term
calendarRules.description: Kansas law allows qualifying parent-teacher conference time and certain staff-development or inservice time to count toward the school term, but the district calendar determines whether students attend.

stateSections.label: Four Reviewed Kansas Calendars, Four Different Openings
stateSections.content: The four reviewed 2026–27 calendars share a mid-August opening window, but only Wichita publishes one general first day. The Kansas City-area districts use grade-specific or program-specific starts.

stateSections.label: The Reviewed Districts Share Spring Break but Not Every Return Date
stateSections.content: All four reviewed 2026–27 calendars list their main Spring Break or Spring Recess for March 15–19. That agreement should not be treated as a statewide Kansas rule. Thanksgiving and winter schedules already show local differences: Blue Valley, Olathe, and Shawnee Mission begin their Thanksgiving break November 23, while Wichita begins Fall Recess November 24. Blue Valley and Wichita explicitly return January 5 after winter recess; Olathe returns January 6 after two professional days, and Shawnee Mission's Winter Break runs through January 4.

stateSections.label: Kansas City Public Schools Is a Missouri District
stateSections.content: Kansas City Public Schools serves Kansas City, Missouri, so its calendar appears in the Missouri collection. The reviewed Kansas-side calendar pages in the Kansas City metro are Blue Valley Schools, Olathe Public Schools, and Shawnee Mission School District. Families should confirm the state and district name before using a calendar because Kansas City-area search results can include districts on both sides of the state line.

stateSections.label: Official Kansas Calendar Rules and District Sources
stateSections.content: Kansas law and KSDE guidance establish school-term and auditing requirements. District calendar hubs and adopted calendar files remain the sources of record for actual student dates, grade-level attendance rules, revisions, and school-specific follow-up.

collectionDescription: Four Kansas district pages currently include reviewed 2026–27 and 2027–28 dates, official sources, grade-specific planning notes, PDFs, and one-time ICS downloads.
planningTips: Choose the district and the student's grade or program before using a first or last day. Three of the four reviewed districts use staggered openings.
Read the attendance scope on conference, collaboration, professional-learning, and early-dismissal dates. A date may apply to only certain grades.
Check the staff or inservice dates next to Winter Break. A printed break end does not always mean students return the next morning.
Treat possible inclement-weather dates as conditional until the district announces that students will attend.
Recheck the official district or school calendar after a closure or revision. MySchoolDates ICS files are one-time imports and do not update automatically.
commonHolidaysDescription: These holidays or breaks appear across the reviewed Kansas calendars, but their ranges, adjacent staff days, return dates, and grade-level effects are set locally.

faqs.q: Does Kansas have one statewide public school calendar?
faqs.a: No. Kansas law sets the minimum school term, but local districts publish their own first days, breaks, professional days, conferences, early dismissals, weather plans, and last days. Families should use the calendar for their assigned district, school, grade, and program.

faqs.q: When do Kansas schools start in 2026?
faqs.a: There is no single statewide start date. In this reviewed collection, Blue Valley and Shawnee Mission begin selected grades August 12, 2026. Olathe begins selected grades August 13, and Wichita's general first day is August 13 after new-student orientation August 12.

faqs.q: How many school days or hours does Kansas require?
faqs.a: K.S.A. 72-3115 sets a days-based minimum of 186 days for kindergarten through grade 11 and 181 days for grade 12. A local board may adopt an hourly term with at least 465 kindergarten hours, 1,116 hours for grades 1–11, and 1,086 hours for grade 12.

faqs.q: When is Spring Break in Kansas in 2027?
faqs.a: Kansas has no statewide Spring Break. All four districts currently reviewed here list March 15–19, 2027, but that shared week is a feature of this district sample, not a state requirement. Other Kansas districts and individual programs may publish different dates.

faqs.q: Can weather change a Kansas school calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. Kansas law allows a district board or its designee to close schools when hazardous driving conditions are expected and permits compensatory days or hours. Districts decide how published make-up dates or calendar adjustments affect students, so families should check local announcements after a closure.

faqs.q: Is Kansas City Public Schools part of the Kansas calendar directory?
faqs.a: No. Kansas City Public Schools serves Kansas City, Missouri, and appears in the Missouri collection. The reviewed Kansas-side Kansas City metro districts are Blue Valley Schools, Olathe Public Schools, and Shawnee Mission School District.

faqs.q: Can I add a Kansas school calendar to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. Reviewed Kansas district pages provide ICS files for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. Each file is a one-time import and will not automatically reflect later district revisions, school events, conference times, or weather changes.
